title: Make executor recovery content refusals visible without starving later rows
outcome: Make executor recovery content refusals visible without starving later rows
acceptance: Recovery reports journal read/content failures and distinguishes deterministic per-row refusal from transient storage failure; a permanently refused row cannot silently starve later admissible work, and I/O failure retains retry ownership.
Focused controls cover corrupt or invalid retained content, later valid rows and transient I/O without deleting unknown effects or weakening authority; full gate and independent review pass.
